pages.title: Fully Funded Danish Government Scholarship for International Master's Students
pages.description: The Danish Government offers a fully funded master’s scholarship for international students at the University of Southern Denmark. Apply now to enjoy tuition waivers and study in vibrant Denmark.
pages.content:
Overview: The Danish Government Scholarship provides a fully funded opportunity for international students pursuing a master’s degree at the University of Southern Denmark, covering the full tuition fee.

Eligibility

  • International applicants with a recognized bachelor’s degree.
  • Proficiency in English (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90).
  • Meet the admission criteria of the University of Southern Denmark.

Benefits

  • 100% tuition fee waiver.
  • Access to university facilities and support services.
  • Opportunity to live and study in Denmark, an innovative and safe European hub.

Deadline

Application deadlines vary by program; please visit the official scholarship page for the most current deadline.

pages.title: New Zealand Manaaki Scholarships 2026-2027: Fully Funded Opportunities for International Master & PhD Students

pages.title: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA) 2027: Fully Funded PhD Scholarship for Global Talent

pages.title: 2027 Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC): Fully Funded Master & PhD Opportunities
pages.description: Discover the 2027 Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC) that fully fund Master’s and PhD studies across all disciplines. Apply now for tuition waivers, housing, insurance, and generous stipends.
pages.content:
Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC) 2027 offer international students a chance to pursue Master’s and PhD degrees in China with comprehensive financial support. Backed by the Ministry of Education, these scholarships cover tuition, accommodation, medical insurance, and a monthly stipend.

Eligibility

  • Non‑Chinese citizens in good health.
  • Applicants for Master’s or PhD programs in any academic discipline.
  • Hold a bachelor’s degree (for Master’s) or a master’s degree (for PhD) with strong academic records.
  • Meet language requirements (Chinese‑taught programs usually require HSK, English‑taught programs require TOEFL/IELTS).

Benefits

  • Full tuition waiver.
  • Free university housing or a housing allowance.
  • Comprehensive medical insurance.
  • Monthly living stipend (up to 3,500 CNY for doctoral candidates).
  • Travel allowance for round‑trip airfare (optional, varies by university).

Deadline

The exact application deadline for 2027 has not been published yet, but the scholarship cycle typically opens in March and closes by early June. Keep an eye on the official portal for updates.

For detailed guidelines and to start your application, visit the official scholarship page.

pages.title: Fully Funded Eni MiNDS Master’s Scholarship 2027 Italy
pages.description: The Eni MiNDS Master’s Scholarship offers a fully funded 12‑month master’s in Italy for STEM graduates, covering tuition, a €1,500 monthly stipend and a corporate internship. Applications close on 1 October 2026 for the 2027 cohort.
pages.content:
Overview

The Eni MiNDS Master’s Scholarship 2027, hosted by Politecnico di Torino in Turin, Italy, provides a fully funded 2nd‑level specialized master’s (80 ECTS) focused on natural resources development and sustainable storage. Funded by Eni SpA, the program blends eight months of academic coursework with a four‑month corporate internship at Eni facilities.

Eligibility

  • All nationalities (both non‑Italian applicants and Italian citizens)
  • Age under 30 years at the application deadline
  • Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, physics, mathematics, geology, geophysics or related fields
  • Minimum academic score equivalent to 100/110 in the Italian grading system
  • Proof of English proficiency (IELTS, TOEFL or equivalent)

Benefits

  • Full tuition fee waiver paid directly to Politecnico di Torino
  • Monthly stipend of €1,500 (total €18,000 for the year)
  • Subsidised corporate canteen access and accommodation guidance
  • Comprehensive health and accident insurance coverage
  • Paid four‑month corporate internship at Eni facilities

Program Structure

  • 8 months of academic classes at Politecnico di Torino campus
  • 4 months of hands‑on corporate internship with Eni
  • Completion of 80 ECTS leading to a 2nd‑level specializing master’s degree

Application Deadline

Applications close on 1 October 2026 for the 2027 intake (January 2027 – January 2028). Early submission is encouraged.

pages.title: 6 Fully Funded Scholarships Opening 2027 – Calendar & Prep Guide
pages.description: Six world‑leading fully funded scholarships open between August 2026 and February 2027. Get the dates, benefits and early‑action steps so you can secure a spot for the 2027 intake.
pages.content:
The 2027 fully funded scholarship cycle kicks off between August 2026 and February 2027. Preparing now lets you target three or four programmes before the competition heats up.

Chevening Scholarship – United Kingdom

  • Eligibility: Minimum two years (≈2,800 hours) work experience, leadership potential, undergraduate degree, English proficiency.
  • Benefits: Full tuition, monthly living stipend, return flights, arrival allowance, visa fee.
  • Application window: Opens early August 2026, closes early October 2026.
  • Action steps: Shortlist three UK programmes, secure two referees, draft four required essays (leadership, networking, study plan, career plan). Official site

DAAD Scholarships (incl. EPOS) – Germany

  • Eligibility: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree for master’s track; research proposal for PhD track; German language not mandatory.
  • Benefits: Tuition waiver, monthly stipend (~€992 for master’s), health insurance, travel support, German language course.
  • Application window: University‑specific deadlines clustered June–November 2026.
  • Action steps: Identify up to three EPOS programmes, contact potential supervisors early, track each university’s portal. Official site

Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) – South Korea

  • Eligibility: Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD candidates; no IELTS/TOEFL required; must submit notarised, translated documents.
  • Benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, airfare, settlement allowance, medical insurance, one year of free Korean language training.
  • Application window: Opens around September 2026 (embassy track closes first).
  • Action steps: Follow nearest Korean embassy and the Study in Korea portal, begin gathering paperwork, decide between Embassy and University tracks. Official site

Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters – Europe

  • Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree, strong academic record, English (or programme language) proficiency.
  • Benefits: Tuition covered, monthly allowance, travel costs, joint degree from multiple European universities.
  • Application window: Calls open ~October 2026; deadlines Dec 2026–Jan 2027.
  • Action steps: Browse the Erasmus Mundus catalogue, select 2‑3 joint programmes, prepare separate applications for each consortium. Official site

Stipendium Hungaricum – Hungary

  • Eligibility: Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD candidates; minimum GPA 3.0 (or equivalent); English/Hungarian proficiency as required.
  • Benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, travel insurance, Hungarian language course.
  • Application window: Opens ~November 2026, deadline ~15 January 2027.
  • Action steps: Register on the Stipendium Hungaricum portal, choose up to three study programmes, prepare transcripts and language certificates early. Official site

Swedish Institute Study Grants (SISGP) – Sweden

  • Eligibility: Master’s applicants with a Bachelor’s degree; English proficiency; leadership or community involvement.
  • Benefits: Full tuition, monthly living allowance, travel grant, insurance.
  • Application window: University applications ~October 2026–January 2027; scholarship decisions ~February 2027.
  • Action steps: Identify Swedish universities participating in SISGP, prepare a concise motivation letter and two references, monitor each university’s portal for exact dates. Official site

pages.title: Unlock Your Academic Dreams: The Prestigious France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program
pages.description: Dreaming of a world-class Master's or PhD in France? The France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship offers fully funded opportunities for outstanding international students. Discover how this prestigious program can transform your academic journey and career.
pages.content:
France, a global leader in education and innovation, invites the brightest minds from around the world to pursue their academic aspirations. Spearheading this initiative is the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program, a prestigious award managed by Campus France that opens doors to unparalleled educational and professional growth.

If you're an ambitious international student with an excellent academic record, a Master's or PhD in France could be within your reach, fully funded by this distinguished scholarship.

What is the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program?

The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is more than just financial aid; it's an investment in future leaders. Established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, its primary goal is to promote educational excellence in France and attract top international students to its Master's and PhD programs. It helps foster international cooperation and strengthens the academic and scientific ties between France and other nations.

Why Choose the Eiffel Scholarship? (Benefits)

Securing an Eiffel Scholarship means more than just financial relief; it’s an assurance of a high-quality academic experience with significant support. While specific amounts can vary annually, recipients typically benefit from:

  • Monthly Allowance: A generous monthly stipend to cover living expenses, ensuring you can focus entirely on your studies.
  • Travel Expenses: Coverage for international return travel from your home country to France.
  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for the duration of your stay.
  • Cultural Activities: Access to various cultural activities and events, enriching your French experience.
  • Priority Housing: Assistance with finding suitable accommodation in France.
  • Tuition Fees: While the Eiffel scholarship itself doesn't directly cover university tuition fees, students enrolled at public institutions are often exempt from tuition fees by the French government. The scholarship ensures all other significant living and travel costs are covered.

Are You Eligible? (Key Criteria)

The Eiffel scholarship is highly competitive, seeking candidates who demonstrate exceptional academic potential. While specific criteria may vary slightly, general eligibility typically includes:

  • Nationality: Applicants must be foreign nationals. Candidates with dual nationality, one of which is French, are generally not eligible.
  • Age Limit: Candidates applying for a Master's program must usually be no older than 25 years old at the time of the application campaign. For PhD programs, the age limit is typically 30 years old.
  • Academic Excellence: A strong academic record from previous studies is crucial.
  • Program Level: The scholarship is exclusively for Master's and PhD level studies.
  • First-Time Application: Candidates who have previously received the Eiffel scholarship for the same level of study are not eligible.
  • Admission: Applicants must be admitted or in the process of being admitted to a Master's or PhD program at a French higher education institution.

Navigating the Application Process

Unlike many other scholarships, candidates cannot directly apply for the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship. Applications must be submitted by French higher education institutions that wish to host the international students. This means you first need to gain admission to a French university or grande école, and then that institution will nominate you for the scholarship. Therefore, establishing contact with your desired French institution well in advance is paramount.

Important Deadlines

The application window for the Eiffel Scholarship typically opens in the fall of each year, with institutional submissions occurring over the subsequent months. As the application process is handled by French institutions, it is crucial to check the official Campus France website and the websites of your target French universities for the exact and most up-to-date deadlines. Institutions often have their own internal deadlines for submitting applications to Campus France, which are much earlier than the final Campus France deadline.

Your Path to French Academic Excellence

The France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program is a gateway to an enriching academic and cultural experience in France. If you possess a stellar academic record and a dream to pursue advanced studies in a vibrant international environment, this fully funded opportunity awaits. Don't miss the chance to become part of France's academic elite.

Begin your journey today by exploring programs at French universities and contacting them regarding the Eiffel scholarship!

pages.title: Fully Funded Scholarships for International Students, 2026-2027
pages.description: Explore a comprehensive compilation of fully funded scholarships for international students spanning undergraduate, master's, PhD, and postdoctoral levels. These opportunities cover tuition, living expenses, health insurance, and more, enabling you to study across various countries and disciplines.
pages.content:
Numerous scholarships are offered to international students to study abroad. However, not all scholarships provide coverage for all expenses, and some scholarship winners still have a hard time funding their studies. In this post, you will find a compilation of the 2026-2027 fully funded scholarships for international students that are open for application. These scholarships provide necessary funding for your studies. Scholarships on this page may cover all or most of the following items: tuition fees, monthly stipend, health insurance, flight tickets, research allowance, conference attendance fees, etc.

This list of fully funded scholarships for international students is open for studies in a wide range of domains (from arts and humanities to science and engineering) to foreign students and students from developing countries. You can study or conduct research at undergraduate, master’s, doctoral, and postdoctoral degree levels or receive short-term training. Most of these fully funded scholarships are provided by governments, while the rest are from universities, organizations, and institutions. These scholarships will allow you to travel and study in different countries in the world. You will experience different cultures, discover new things, make lifelong friends, and become a resourceful person.

How to Apply

To apply for any of these scholarships, please click on its name. You will be redirected to a page that contains detailed information on eligibility criteria, benefits, and application procedures. Make sure you meet the eligibility criteria and follow the instructions given to submit your application before the deadline. While the application process for most of the fully funded scholarships does not require you to pay any fees, you may be asked to pay application fees for some. Just make sure you’re sending your money to the scholarship provider if there is an application fee.

Important Note

Note: Never pay anyone who pretends to work for greatyop, great youth opportunity, or whatever name that relates to greatyop.com for application processing, admission letter, or any service.

1. Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships

The Switzerland scholarship is offered by the Swiss Government and granted for research (Master’s, PhD, Postdoctoral & Research) in one of the Swiss public universities, Federal Institutes of Technology, University of Applied Sciences, or Schools of music and arts. This is a fully funded scholarship program for international students and is valid only for full-time research and studies in Switzerland. This government scholarship program has four categories namely: the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship for master’s in art, for PhD in all fields, for Postdoctoral in all fields, and for Research in all fields.

  • Level of Study: Masters, PhD, Research.
  • Deadline: November 30, 2026.
  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

2. Belgium Government Scholarship (ARES)

The program offers candidates a chance to pursue a one-year advanced bachelor’s or master’s degree program or a 2-to-6-month continuing education program within a higher education institution of the Wallonia-Brussels Federation in Belgium. The program is open to nationals of developing countries with professional experience looking to further develop their skills in a development-related topic. This scholarship is fully funded and provides a round-trip ticket per academic year, living allowance, registration fees, insurance fees, etc.

  • Level of Study: Short Course, Undergraduate, Masters.
  • Deadline: September 18, 2026.
  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

3. Russian Government Scholarship (Open Doors Scholarship)

The scholarship is awarded to talented international students who want to study a Master’s or PhD degree at Russian universities. It is the sixth year the Russian Federation has organized the Open Doors International Olympiad. Winners and prize-winners of the Olympiad can choose any field of study from one of the subject areas of the Olympiad and one or several universities in Russia providing their program.

  • Level of Study: Undergraduate, Masters, PhD, Postdoctoral, Research.
  • Deadline: November 13, 2026.
  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

4. Science Tokyo IGP(C) Scholarship for International Students

The Institute of Science Tokyo is now accepting applications for its International Graduate Program (IGP(C)) for April 2027 enrollment. The Science Tokyo IGP(C) Scholarship is for international students who want to pursue a master’s, doctoral, or integrated doctoral education program, all taught entirely in English. You must first get a consent letter from a faculty member at Science Tokyo who agrees to be your supervisor, and you need to email a copy of that letter to the Admissions Division by the deadline. Selected candidates may apply for the JASSO Reservation Program for Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students or JASSO scholarship.

  • Level of Study: Masters, PhD, Research.
  • Deadline: October 11, 2026.
  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

5. UK Government Chevening Scholarships for Foreign Students

Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year Master’s degrees programs in the United Kingdom. The program is looking for the kind of people who have the passion, ideas, and influence to provide the solutions and leadership needed to create a better future. Applicants can choose from more than 12,000 Master’s courses offered by more than 150 UK higher education institutions. The scholarship is a fully funded program that provides tuition fees, living allowance to cover accommodation and living expenses, airfare, arrival allowance, a homeward departure allowance, etc.

  • Level of Study: Masters, Research.
  • Deadline: October 6, 2026.
  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

6. Germany Scholarships for Studies in All Academic Disciplines

These German Scholarships are fully funded for qualified graduates who have completed their first degree at the latest by the time they commence their program. The program usually starts on 1st October of the following year after the application, or earlier if a German language course is taken prior to the study program. The scholarship is offered for a Master’s degree program (and also for Ph.D. studies under certain conditions) in all fields of study at state or state-recognized German universities.

  • Level of Study: Masters.
  • Deadline: December 1, 2026.
  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

7. DAAD Scholarship to Study Architecture in Germany

This Germany scholarship program is open to foreign applicants.

  • Click here for detailed information on the eligibility requirements and the application process.

pages.title: Unlock Your AI Future: Fully Funded MBZUAI Master's & PhD Scholarships 2026-27
pages.description: Dreaming of a career at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence? The Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) is offering fully funded Master's and PhD scholarships for the 2026-27 academic year. Discover how to secure your spot in this prestigious UAE-based program.
pages.content:
Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence and aspire to lead the next wave of technological innovation? The Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) in Abu Dhabi, UAE, presents an unparalleled opportunity for aspiring scholars worldwide. The MBZUAI Scholarship Program 2026-27 offers fully funded Master's and PhD positions, inviting brilliant minds to contribute to cutting-edge AI research and development.

MBZUAI is the world's first graduate-level, research-based AI university, dedicated to advancing scientific research in Artificial Intelligence. This is your chance to study in a dynamic, state-of-the-art environment, with comprehensive support to fuel your academic and research ambitions.

Scholarship Benefits: What Awaits You?

The MBZUAI Scholarship is designed to ensure that financial constraints do not hinder your pursuit of excellence. This is a truly comprehensive package, covering all essential aspects of your academic journey and life in the UAE:

  • Full Tuition Coverage: All academic expenses are taken care of, allowing you to focus entirely on your studies and research.
  • Comprehensive Health Insurance: Enjoy peace of mind with extensive health coverage throughout your program.
  • Visa Sponsorship: For international students, MBZUAI provides visa sponsorship, making your relocation smooth and hassle-free.
  • Generous Monthly Stipend:

  • Accommodation: Access to modern, comfortable university accommodation.
  • State-of-the-Art Facilities: Engage with world-class faculty and utilize cutting-edge research infrastructure.

Eligibility Criteria: Are You the Right Candidate?

For Master's Applicants (MSc in AI)

  • A 4-year Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.
  • A strong academic record, typically with a minimum CGPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or its equivalent.
  • Proficiency in English, demonstrated by:
    • TOEFL iBT score of 90+, or
    • IELTS Academic score of 6.0+.

For PhD Applicants (PhD in AI)

  • Both a Bachelor's and a Master's degree from accredited universities.
  • A consistently strong academic performance, with a minimum CGPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale or its equivalent in both degrees.
  • Proven English proficiency (same as Master's requirements):
    • TOEFL iBT score of 90+, or
    • IELTS Academic score of 6.0+.
  • A compelling research proposal outlining your intended PhD research area and objectives.

General Application Requirements for Both Programs

  • Two strong recommendation letters from academic or professional referees.
  • A well-crafted Statement of Purpose articulating your academic background, research interests, and why you wish to study at MBZUAI.

Application Process & Key Documents

To successfully apply for the MBZUAI Scholarship Program, you will need to prepare a comprehensive application package. Ensure all documents are accurate and reflective of your best work.

  • Official academic transcripts from all previous institutions.
  • Degree certificates.
  • Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS scores).
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • Statement of Purpose.
  • Research Proposal (for PhD applicants).
  • Two Letters of Recommendation.
  • Valid passport copy.

Deadline to Apply

While the opportunity for 2026-27 is open, specific application deadlines for this cycle will be announced on the official MBZUAI admissions portal. It is highly recommended to visit the official website frequently and prepare your application well in advance.

Don't miss this incredible chance to join a global hub of Artificial Intelligence innovation. The MBZUAI Scholarship Program is more than just funding; it's an investment in your future, offering a launchpad for a successful career in a rapidly evolving field. Take the first step towards transforming your academic and professional trajectory by applying to MBZUAI today!

pages.title: Fully Funded Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Master's Scholarship 2027
pages.description: Unlock your potential with the fully funded Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Master's Scholarship 2027, designed for international students passionate about Research and Innovation in Higher Education. This prestigious two-year program offers a monthly stipend of €1,400, full tuition coverage, and global study opportunities across Europe and Asia.
pages.content:
The Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Scholarship 2027 is now open for students interested in pursuing a two-year international Master's degree focused on Research and Innovation in Higher Education. The MARIHE programme prepares graduates for careers in university management, higher-education policy, research administration, innovation, and institutional leadership.

The programme lasts two years and carries 120 ECTS credits. Students study through an international consortium involving universities and institutions across Europe and Asia.

One important feature makes MARIHE different from many other Erasmus Mundus programmes: students selected for the MARIHE programme receive a tuition-fee scholarship, while a limited number of students also receive the full Erasmus Mundus Scholarship with €1,400 per month.

Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Scholarship 2027 Overview

  • Programme: MARIHE – Master in Research and Innovation in Higher Education
  • Scholarship Type: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarship
  • Degree Level: Master's Degree
  • Duration: 2 years
  • Credits: 120 ECTS
  • Field: Higher Education, Research, Innovation, and University Management
  • Eligible Nationalities: International students
  • Monthly Scholarship: €1,400 for Erasmus Mundus Scholarship recipients
  • Tuition Support: Tuition-fee scholarship for selected MARIHE students
  • Study Locations: Europe and Asia
  • Internship: Minimum 8 weeks
  • Intake: 2027

Degree Level

The MARIHE programme is a Master's degree designed for graduates who want to develop expertise in higher education, research systems, innovation, and institutional management. The programme lasts two years and consists of 120 ECTS credits.

Students do not remain at a single university throughout the entire programme. The international structure gives participants the opportunity to study in different countries and gain experience with different higher-education systems.

Available Subjects

MARIHE is focused on the systems and institutions that shape higher education and research. The programme can be particularly relevant to students interested in:

  • Higher education management
  • University administration
  • Research management
  • Education policy
  • Innovation management
  • Institutional leadership
  • Internationalisation of higher education
  • Digital transformation
  • Research and innovation systems
  • Student mobility
  • Higher-education strategy
  • Institutional development
  • Education consulting

The programme is therefore not limited to traditional education graduates.

Who Can Apply

One of the major advantages of MARIHE is its broad academic eligibility. Applicants can come from a wide range of academic backgrounds, provided they hold a qualifying first university degree of at least three years. Potential applicants may have backgrounds in:

  • Education
  • Engineering
  • Business
  • Economics
  • Computer Science
  • Information Technology
  • Social Sciences
  • Humanities
  • Public Policy
  • International Relations
  • Management
  • Other relevant academic disciplines

You do not necessarily need a Bachelor's degree in Education. Instead, applicants should demonstrate a genuine academic or professional interest in higher education, research systems, innovation, or institutional development.

Benefits

€1,400 Monthly Scholarship

Students selected for the Erasmus Mundus Scholarship receive €1,400 per month. The monthly allowance is intended to help cover expenses associated with:

  • Living costs
  • Travel
  • Visa expenses
  • Installation costs

The monthly payment is an important part of the full Erasmus Mundus funding package.

Tuition-Fee Scholarship

A key point about MARIHE is that admission to the programme and the full Erasmus Mundus Scholarship are not exactly the same thing. Selected MARIHE students receive a tuition-fee scholarship covering programme participation costs. A limited number of students then receive the additional Erasmus Mundus Scholarship, which provides the €1,400 monthly support and other benefits.

Health and Accident Insurance

Erasmus Mundus Scholarship recipients receive worldwide health and accident insurance under the programme's scholarship arrangements.

International Mobility

Students have the opportunity to study across several countries rather than completing the entire Master's degree at one institution. The consortium extends across countries including:

  • Austria
  • Finland
  • Germany
  • Hungary
  • Portugal
  • China
  • India

Students can select from five European and two Asian specialisation options, according to the programme structure.

International Internship

MARIHE includes a compulsory internship lasting at least eight weeks. The internship can provide practical experience with organisations such as:

  • Universities
  • Research organisations
  • Government institutions
  • Higher-education organisations
  • Other relevant institutions

Eligible Nationalities

The MARIHE programme is designed for international applicants and provides an opportunity for students from different countries to study within an international academic environment. Applicants from outside Europe can therefore consider MARIHE as an option for gaining a European and international Master's education. Candidates should review the official programme requirements for the specific intake to confirm the applicable nationality and admission conditions.

Eligibility Criteria

Applicants should meet the academic and programme-specific admission requirements.

Academic Qualification

Applicants need a qualifying first university degree of at least three years. The degree does not have to be specifically in Education. Graduates from different academic backgrounds can be considered if their academic and professional interests fit the programme.

Interest in Higher Education

Because MARIHE focuses on higher-education systems, research, and innovation, applicants should demonstrate a clear reason for choosing this field. Strong applications can connect: Previous academic or professional experience → a specific higher-education problem → future career goals → why MARIHE is suitable.

Professional Experience

Fresh graduates are not automatically excluded. Applicants with limited professional experience can demonstrate their interest through:

  • Internships
  • Research projects
  • Student leadership
  • University activities
  • Volunteering
  • Academic projects
  • Relevant employment

Professional experience can strengthen an application, but applicants should focus on demonstrating their genuine interest in higher-education systems and institutional change.

English Language Requirements

Applicants should also meet the programme's English-language requirements. Candidates should carefully check the current official MARIHE admission information for accepted English-language qualifications, minimum scores, and any exemptions before submitting an application.

How to Make Your Application Competitive

MARIHE is not simply a scholarship for students who want to study somewhere in Europe. A stronger application should demonstrate a genuine academic or professional interest in higher education, research systems, innovation, or institutional development, connecting past experiences with future aspirations and why MARIHE is the ideal fit.

Application Deadline

The application deadline for the Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Scholarship 2027 is September 21, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. CEST.

pages.title: Unlock Your French Dream: Fully Funded France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027 (Master's & PhD)
pages.description: Ready to pursue your Master's or PhD in France with comprehensive financial support? The prestigious France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027 offers an incredible opportunity for international students to study at top French institutions.
pages.content:
Are you an ambitious international student with dreams of pursuing a world-class Master's or PhD degree in France? The French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, through Campus France, is proud to present the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027, an unparalleled opportunity designed to attract elite foreign students to French higher education institutions.

This fully funded scholarship program aims to foster international cooperation and support future leaders in various fields. If you're looking for comprehensive financial backing and an immersive cultural experience, the Eiffel Scholarship could be your gateway to academic excellence in the heart of Europe.

Eligibility for the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027

To be considered for this prestigious scholarship, applicants must meet specific criteria:

  • Applicants must be international students.
  • For Master's and Engineering degrees, applicants must be under 29 years old at the time of application.
  • For Doctoral degrees, applicants must be under 35 years old at the time of application.
  • Crucially, direct student applications are not accepted. All candidates must be nominated by a French higher education institution. This means you first need to gain admission to a French university or grande école, and they, in turn, will submit your application for the Eiffel Scholarship.
  • The scholarship supports studies in Science and Technology (Biology and Health, Ecological Transition, Mathematics and Digital Sciences, Engineering Sciences) and Humanities and Social Sciences (History, French Language and Civilization, Law and Political Sciences, Economics and Management).

Unbeatable Benefits of the Eiffel Scholarship

The France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship is designed to provide comprehensive financial support, ensuring you can focus entirely on your studies and cultural immersion:

  • Monthly Allowance:
    • For Master's students: €1,200 per month.
    • For Doctoral students: €2,100 per month.
  • Transportation: International return ticket from your home country to France, and national transportation within France (where applicable).
  • Insurance: Health insurance coverage.
  • Housing Assistance: Help finding accommodation and supplementary housing allowance.
  • Cultural Activities: Access to various cultural events and activities to enrich your stay in France.

Key Information & Application Process

Remember, the application process for the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship is unique. You cannot apply directly. You must first apply to a French higher education institution. If accepted, the institution will then decide whether to nominate you for the Eiffel Scholarship. It's essential to start your university applications early to allow institutions ample time to consider your nomination.

For more detailed information and to prepare your nomination, prospective students should contact the international relations department of their chosen French institutions well in advance.

Deadline

Mark your calendars! The deadline for French institutions to submit their nominations for the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship is January 8, 2027. This means you need to have secured your admission and nomination from your chosen French institution well before this date. Plan ahead!

Don't miss this incredible chance to pursue your academic aspirations in France with the generous support of the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship. Start planning your application to a French institution today!

pages.title: Fully Funded Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028: Your Gateway to Research & Artistic Fields
pages.description: Dreaming of advanced studies in Switzerland? The prestigious Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for 2027-2028 offer fully funded Master's and PhD opportunities for talented researchers and artists worldwide.
pages.content:
Are you an ambitious researcher or a talented artist aspiring to elevate your academic journey in one of the world's most innovative countries? Switzerland, renowned for its academic excellence and stunning landscapes, opens its doors through the highly sought-after Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for 2027-2028. This fully funded opportunity is a golden ticket for international students eager to pursue Master's or PhD degrees.

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships (SGES), spearheaded by the Swiss Confederation, are designed to foster international exchange and bolster research cooperation. These prestigious awards are primarily aimed at nurturing talented early career researchers (ECRs) from around the globe who have completed their Master's degree, allowing them to pursue research scholarships across any academic discipline. Additionally, an exclusive pathway exists for students embarking on an initial Master's degree in an artistic field, known as Art scholarships, though eligibility for these is limited to specific countries.

Eligibility Criteria

To be considered for this esteemed scholarship, applicants must meet specific requirements:

  • Applicants must be under 35 years old at the time of application.
  • For Research Scholarships (PhD, Postdoctoral, or Research periods): You must possess a Master's degree. A crucial requirement is securing an academic supervisor in Switzerland who is willing to support your research project.
  • For Art Scholarships (initial Master's in an artistic field): Specific country limitations apply, and applicants should check the official guidelines for their country's eligibility.
  • The scholarship encourages applications from international students, promoting diverse academic collaborations.

Scholarship Benefits

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are designed to provide comprehensive support, ensuring recipients can focus entirely on their studies and research. Key benefits include:

  • A generous monthly stipend of CHF 2450.-- (Swiss Francs), covering living expenses.
  • Access to world-class research facilities and esteemed academic institutions across Switzerland.
  • Opportunities for professional networking and collaboration in a leading innovation hub.
  • While the monthly stipend is explicitly stated, these scholarships are generally considered fully funded, often covering additional costs like tuition fees, health insurance, and travel allowances, though specific details should always be verified on the official website.

Application Process & Deadline

Planning ahead is crucial for this highly competitive scholarship:

  • Application Opening: Mark your calendars! Applications for the 2027-2028 academic year are slated to open on August 20, 2026.
  • Application Deadline: The specific deadlines for submitting your application will be officially published in August 2026. It is imperative to consult the official website closer to the opening date for the exact closing dates relevant to your country.
  • How to Apply: Detailed application guidelines, required documents, and the online application portal will be available via the official Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships website.

Don't miss this unparalleled chance to advance your academic or artistic career in Switzerland. The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships offer not just financial support, but a gateway to a vibrant academic community and an enriching cultural experience. Start preparing your application now to seize this incredible opportunity for the 2027-2028 academic year!

pages.title: Fully Funded Swiss Excellence: Swiss Government Scholarships for Global South Scholars
pages.description: Dreaming of world-class education in Switzerland? The prestigious Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships offer incredible fully funded opportunities specifically designed for talented individuals from Global South countries. Discover how you can pursue your academic ambitions in the heart of Europe.
pages.content:
Aspiring scholars from the Global South, are you ready to elevate your academic journey on the international stage? The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships present an unparalleled, fully funded opportunity to study in one of the world's most innovative and picturesque countries: Switzerland. This esteemed program is a beacon for academic achievement, inviting bright minds to engage in cutting-edge research and advanced studies.

These scholarships are more than just financial aid; they are an investment in global talent, fostering international cooperation and providing scholars with access to Switzerland's world-renowned universities and research institutions. If you're from a Global South country and possess a strong academic record, this could be your gateway to a transformative international educational experience.

Eligibility for Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships

While specific criteria can vary annually and depending on your country of origin, these prestigious scholarships typically target highly motivated and academically excellent postgraduate students. Key eligibility points generally include:

  • Nationality: Open to citizens from designated Global South countries. Please refer to the official scholarship portal for the complete list of eligible nations.
  • Academic Background: Generally requires a Master's degree for PhD candidates, or a Bachelor's degree for Master's candidates (if applicable for the scholarship type). Strong academic performance and a compelling record are crucial.
  • Research Proposal: For PhD or research scholarships, a well-defined and innovative research proposal, accepted by a Swiss professor, is usually a core requirement.
  • Age Limit: An age limit, often around 35 years old, may apply. This should be verified on the official website.
  • Prior Swiss Residency: Applicants who have been in Switzerland for more than one year at the beginning of the scholarship are usually not eligible.

Please note: The specific types of programs (Master's, PhD, Postdoc) and fields of study for the current cycle are not explicitly detailed in the initial announcement. Candidates are strongly advised to consult the official Swiss Government portal linked below for precise information relevant to their academic aspirations.

Unmatched Benefits: Fully Funded Excellence

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are renowned for being fully funded, providing comprehensive support that allows scholars to focus entirely on their studies and research without financial burdens. The typical benefits package often includes:

  • Monthly Stipend: A generous living allowance to cover daily expenses in Switzerland.
  • Tuition Fees: Often covers university tuition fees, depending on the scholarship type and institution.
  • Health Insurance: Mandatory Swiss health insurance coverage.
  • Travel Allowance: A one-off lump sum for flight tickets to and from Switzerland at the beginning and end of the scholarship.
  • Housing Allowance: May include assistance with housing or a dedicated housing allowance for the first month.
  • Research Support: Additional funds may be available for research expenses, conferences, and participation in academic events.

This comprehensive package ensures that scholars can immerse themselves fully in their academic pursuits and enjoy the high quality of life Switzerland offers.

How to Apply & Critical Deadlines

Securing a Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship is a competitive process that requires meticulous preparation and adherence to specific guidelines.

  • Application Process: Generally involves submitting an extensive online application, academic transcripts, detailed letters of recommendation, a comprehensive research proposal (if applicable), a CV, and other supporting documents.
  • Finding a Supervisor: For PhD and research scholarships, applicants are typically required to secure a letter of acceptance from a professor at a Swiss university who is willing to supervise their research.
  • Official Instructions: It is paramount to download the official application package and country-specific guidelines from the Swiss Government's official scholarship website.

Deadline: While the opportunity details indicate 'Not specified' for the specific deadline, these scholarships typically open for applications in August/September each year, with deadlines often falling between September and December for the academic year starting two years later (e.g., applications in 2024 for the 2026-2027 academic year). It is absolutely critical to check the official scholarship website (linked below) for the most accurate and up-to-date application deadlines for your specific country of origin and desired program. Early application and thorough preparation are always recommended to maximize your chances.

Don't miss this incredible chance to advance your career and research in a world-leading academic environment. The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are a life-changing opportunity for Global South scholars to achieve their academic dreams. Visit the official link today to explore the specific requirements and embark on your journey to Switzerland!

pages.title: Unlock Your Future: The Fully Funded KAUST Scholarship for Master's & PhD
pages.description: Dreaming of advanced studies without the financial burden? The King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) Scholarship offers a fully funded opportunity for international Master's and PhD students. Discover how you can pursue world-class research in Saudi Arabia with comprehensive support.
pages.content:
Are you an ambitious international student eager to pursue groundbreaking research and advanced studies at a global hub of innovation? Look no further than the prestigious King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) Scholarship in Saudi Arabia. This fully funded opportunity is designed to attract top talent worldwide, offering an unparalleled academic experience for Master's and PhD candidates.

KAUST is renowned for its state-of-the-art facilities, world-class faculty, and commitment to cutting-edge scientific and technological advancements. A scholarship here means more than just financial aid; it's an investment in your future, providing a platform to excel in your chosen field and contribute to global challenges.

Eligibility for the KAUST Scholarship

While specific academic requirements may vary by program, the KAUST Scholarship is primarily aimed at high-achieving international students pursuing graduate-level studies. Key considerations generally include:

  • International applicants from all countries are encouraged to apply.
  • Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree for Master's programs or a Master's degree for PhD programs from a recognized institution.
  • A strong academic record in a relevant field of study is essential.
  • Proficiency in English is typically required, often demonstrated through standardized tests like TOEFL or IELTS.
  • Commitment to research and innovation aligns with KAUST's mission.

We encourage prospective applicants to visit the official KAUST admissions page through the link provided below for the most up-to-date and detailed eligibility criteria for their specific program of interest.

Unmatched Scholarship Benefits

The KAUST Scholarship is celebrated for its comprehensive financial support, ensuring students can focus entirely on their studies and research without financial stress. Benefits include:

  • Full Free Tuition Support: No tuition fees for the entire duration of your Master's or PhD program.
  • Annual Living Allowance: A generous stipend of up to $30,000 USD per year to cover living expenses.
  • On-Campus Housing: Comfortable, fully subsidized accommodation provided on KAUST's modern campus.
  • Medical and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive health insurance to ensure your well-being.
  • Relocation Support: Assistance with travel expenses to Saudi Arabia, making your transition smooth.

Application Process and Deadline

The King Abdullah University of Science and Technology typically has specific application windows, and it's crucial to prepare your application materials well in advance. While there isn't a single universal deadline, KAUST often conducts multiple admission rounds throughout the year.

To apply, you will generally need to submit:

  • Your academic transcripts and degrees.
  • Letters of recommendation.
  • A statement of purpose outlining your research interests and academic goals.
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • English language proficiency scores (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS).

For the most accurate and current application deadlines, specific program requirements, and to begin your application, please visit the official KAUST admissions portal via the link below. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to advance your academic and research career at one of the world's fastest-rising universities!

pages.title: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027: Fully Funded Master's & PhD in France!
pages.description: Dreaming of a world-class education in France? The France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027 offers fully funded opportunities for outstanding international students pursuing Master's, Engineering, or PhD programs in priority fields.
pages.content:
Are you an ambitious international student with dreams of pursuing higher education in the heart of Europe? The prestigious France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2027 is your gateway to a fully funded Master's, Engineering, or PhD degree in France! This highly competitive scholarship program is designed to attract top international talent to French higher education institutions.

What is the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship?

Initiated by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and managed by Campus France, the Eiffel Scholarship program aims to support outstanding international students. It allows future foreign decision-makers to pursue their studies in priority fields at French universities and Grandes Écoles, fostering cultural exchange and academic excellence.

Eligibility Criteria

To be considered for this esteemed scholarship, candidates must meet specific requirements:

  • Nationality: Applicants must be of foreign nationality. Candidates with dual French nationality are not eligible.
  • Age Limit:
    • For Master's and Engineering programs: Candidates must be under 29 years old at the time of the selection committee.
    • For PhD programs: Candidates must be under 35 years old at the time of the selection committee.
  • Academic Excellence: A strong academic record demonstrating exceptional achievement in previous studies is essential.
  • Fields of Study: The scholarship prioritizes specific academic disciplines:
    • Science and Technology: Biology and Health, Ecological Transition, Mathematics and Digital Sciences, Engineering Sciences.
    • Humanities and Social Sciences: History, French Language and Civilization, Law and Political Science, Economics and Management.
  • Admission to a French Institution: You must be admitted or in the process of being admitted to a Master's, Engineering, or Doctoral program at a French higher education institution.
  • Application Process: Crucially, applications are submitted by French higher education institutions on behalf of the students, not directly by students themselves.

Unrivaled Benefits

The France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship is a comprehensive scholarship that covers a significant portion of a student's expenses, ensuring a worry-free academic journey:

  • Monthly Allowance:
    • Master's & Engineering Students: A generous monthly stipend of €1,200.
    • PhD Students: A substantial monthly stipend of €2,100.
  • Transportation: Coverage for international round-trip transportation from your home country to France, as well as national transportation within France.
  • Insurance: Comprehensive health insurance.
  • Housing Assistance: Support with finding accommodation and potential housing subsidies.
  • Cultural Activities: Access to cultural activities and events, enriching your experience in France.

Important: How to Apply

Unlike many scholarships, students cannot apply directly for the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship. The application process is managed entirely by French higher education institutions. If you are interested:

  1. Identify French universities or Grandes Écoles that offer your desired Master's, Engineering, or PhD program in the eligible fields.
  2. Apply to these institutions directly for your chosen program.
  3. Express your interest in being nominated for the Eiffel Scholarship to the institution during your application process.
  4. If the institution deems you an exceptional candidate, they will submit your application to Campus France for the Eiffel Scholarship program.

It is highly recommended to contact the international relations office of your target French institutions well in advance to understand their internal deadlines and nomination procedures for the Eiffel Scholarship.

Deadline for Institutions to Apply

The deadline for French institutions to submit candidate applications to Campus France for the 2027 intake is January 8, 2027.

Don't miss this incredible opportunity to study in France with the prestigious France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship. Start preparing your applications to French institutions now and pave your way to an enriching academic and cultural experience!

pages.title: Unlock Your Academic Future: Fully Funded DAAD Scholarships in Germany
pages.description: Dreaming of world-class education in Germany? The prestigious DAAD scholarships offer fully funded opportunities for Master's, PhD, Postdoc, and research programs across various fields. Discover how you can pursue your academic ambitions without financial burden.
pages.content:
Are you a bright, ambitious academic looking to advance your career on the global stage? Germany, a hub of innovation and research, offers an unparalleled environment for higher education. The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) stands at the forefront, opening doors for international students and researchers through its esteemed scholarship programs.

These scholarships are more than just financial aid; they are an investment in your potential, providing a pathway to study or conduct research at leading universities and institutions across Germany. If you're ready to take the next big step in your academic journey, a DAAD scholarship might be your perfect match!

What are DAAD Scholarships?

The DAAD is the world's largest funding organization for the international exchange of students and researchers. Its scholarships are designed to support a wide range of academic pursuits, making Germany accessible to talent from around the globe.

  • Opportunity Type: Master's, PhD, Postdoc, and various Research stays.
  • Study Field: Opportunities are available across various academic fields, ensuring that whatever your passion, there might be a program for you.
  • Host Country: All scholarships support study and research visits to universities and non-university research institutions in Germany.

Whether you're looking to delve deeper into a Master's program, embark on groundbreaking doctoral research, or contribute as a seasoned postdoc, DAAD has a program tailored for ambitious scholars.

Eligibility

DAAD scholarships are primarily aimed at highly qualified graduates, doctoral students, and postdocs who wish to undertake study or research in Germany. While specific requirements can vary significantly by program, general criteria often include:

  • A strong academic record in your previous studies.
  • Meeting the language proficiency requirements for your chosen program (German or English).
  • Relevant work experience or research proposals, depending on the program type.
  • Applicants are typically expected to apply from outside Germany, or to be returning to Germany after a period abroad.
  • Citizenship requirements (most DAAD scholarships are open to international applicants from specific countries, or worldwide, depending on the program).

Always check the specific eligibility criteria for the individual scholarship program you are interested in on the official DAAD website.

Benefits of a DAAD Scholarship

One of the most attractive aspects of DAAD scholarships is their comprehensive nature, often providing fully funded support designed to cover the majority of your expenses. Successful applicants typically receive:

  • Monthly Scholarship Payment: A substantial stipend to cover living costs. For example, €992 for students (Master's), and €1,300 for PhD students. Rates for postdocs and researchers may vary.
  • Flat-Rate Travel Allowance: Assistance with the cost of travel to and from Germany.
  • Comprehensive Insurance: Often includes health, accident, and personal liability insurance, providing peace of mind during your stay.
  • Other Allowances: Depending on the program, additional benefits like rent subsidies, family allowances, or study grants may be available.

Crucially, DAAD scholarships do not have to be paid back, allowing you to focus entirely on your studies and research without the burden of future debt.

Application Process & Deadline

The application process for DAAD scholarships is highly structured and requires careful preparation. As programs are diverse, so are their application procedures and deadlines:

  • Application Platform: Applications are typically submitted online through the DAAD portal.
  • Required Documents: This often includes academic transcripts, letters of recommendation, a CV, a letter of motivation, and a research proposal or study plan.
  • Deadline: The application deadline varies significantly by program and country of origin. It is imperative to identify your specific program of interest and consult its dedicated deadline well in advance. Some programs have annual cycles, while others may have multiple intake periods.

To ensure you don't miss out, visit the official DAAD scholarship database regularly and start preparing your documents early.

Your Path to Germany Starts Here!

A DAAD scholarship offers an incredible opportunity to immerse yourself in Germany's vibrant academic landscape, connect with leading experts, and advance your career. With generous financial support and a commitment to academic excellence, DAAD is your partner in achieving your international study and research goals.

Don't let this chance pass you by. Explore the possibilities, find the scholarship that fits your aspirations, and take the first step towards an enriching experience in Germany!

For detailed information and to start your application, visit the official DAAD website: DAAD Scholarships Official Website

Administered by the Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS/ESKAS), this scholarship is more than just financial aid; it's a gateway to exceptional academic and artistic growth in one of the world's most innovative countries. Get ready to explore breathtaking landscapes, a rich cultural tapestry, and cutting-edge research facilities while fully supported.

Eligibility Criteria

To be considered for the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship 2027, applicants must meet specific requirements:

  • Applicants must hold a Master's degree completed by July 2027 (for PhD/Research applicants). Master's in Arts applicants usually require a Bachelor's degree.
  • Candidates must have been born after 31 December 1991.
  • A crucial requirement is a mandatory letter of support from a Swiss academic supervisor at your chosen institution. This letter demonstrates the feasibility and academic backing of your proposed research or artistic project.
  • Applicants must be able to demonstrate excellent academic or artistic achievements.
  • Specific country-of-origin requirements may apply, so check the official guidelines for details relevant to your nationality.
  • Please note: Tuition fees are not covered by the scholarship, but the generous monthly stipend is intended to cover living expenses comprehensively.

Scholarship Benefits

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship is designed to provide comprehensive financial support, allowing scholars and artists to focus entirely on their studies and research:

  • A generous monthly stipend of CHF 2,450 (approximately $2,700 USD, subject to exchange rates).
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
  • A dedicated housing grant of CHF 600 to assist with accommodation costs.
  • A Half-Fare Travelcard, providing discounted public transport across Switzerland.
  • For non-EU/EFTA scholars, a return flight allowance is provided at the end of the scholarship period.
  • Access to prestigious Swiss universities, federal institutes of technology, and universities of applied sciences.
  • Opportunity to conduct cutting-edge research or pursue advanced artistic studies in a world-leading environment.

Application Process and Key Dates

The application window for the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship 2027 is a critical period. Here's what you need to know:

  • Applications officially open on 20 August 2026.
  • While a general deadline of 30 September 2026 is indicated for many, it's crucial to note that country-specific deadlines range from September 2026 to early 2027. Always verify the exact deadline for your country of origin through the official FCS/ESKAS website or your country's Swiss embassy/consulate.
  • Remember, securing that letter of support from a Swiss academic supervisor is paramount and often takes time, so start reaching out well in advance of the application opening.
  • The scholarship awards are typically announced in May, and studies commence in September of the award year.

Seize Your Swiss Dream!

Don't miss this incredible chance to elevate your academic or artistic journey in Switzerland. The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship 2027 is a highly competitive yet profoundly rewarding opportunity for those who aspire to excel. Start preparing your application, secure your supervisor's letter, and get ready to experience world-class education and research in one of the most beautiful countries on Earth.

For detailed guidelines and to begin your application, visit the official link: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship 2027 Official Link

pages.description: Dreaming of an international education? Taiwan offers world-class universities, vibrant cultural experiences, and generous scholarships through its Ministry of Education. Discover unparalleled opportunities to study and learn Chinese in the heart of Asia.
pages.content:
Taiwan, a dynamic island nation known for its technological prowess, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage, is rapidly becoming a top destination for international students. The Ministry of Education (MOE) of the Republic of China (Taiwan) is at the forefront of promoting an inclusive and high-quality educational experience for students worldwide.

Why Choose Taiwan for Your Academic Journey?

Taiwan's education system is built on the philosophy of enabling 'each child to become their best possible self'. This commitment extends to international students, offering a nurturing environment for academic and personal growth. Here's what makes Taiwan stand out:

  • Excellence in Education: Access to reputable universities and diverse degree programs.
  • Cultural Immersion: Experience a unique blend of traditional Chinese culture and modern innovation.
  • Affordable Living: Compared to many Western countries, Taiwan offers a high quality of life at a more reasonable cost.
  • Strategic Location: A gateway to Asia, offering opportunities for regional exploration.

Academic Pathways and Opportunities

Whether you're seeking a full degree or a short-term learning experience, Taiwan has something for everyone:

  • University Admission: Explore a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various disciplines. The MOE provides comprehensive school information to help you find your perfect fit.
  • Scholarships: The MOE offers numerous scholarships to support international students, making a world-class education more accessible. Don't miss the chance to apply for these valuable financial aids.
  • Internships: Gain practical experience through various internship opportunities, enhancing your career prospects.
  • Taiwan Experience Education Programs: Engage in unique educational initiatives designed to provide a deeper understanding of Taiwanese culture and society.

Mastering Mandarin: A Global Skill

One of Taiwan's most compelling offerings is the chance to learn Mandarin Chinese. With its clear and traditional character system, Taiwan is an ideal place to master the language:

  • Chinese Language Centers: Reputable centers across the island offer structured and immersive Mandarin courses for all proficiency levels.
  • TOCFL: Test of Chinese as a Foreign Language: Prepare for and take the official TOCFL exam to certify your Mandarin proficiency, a valuable asset for your academic and professional future.

Stay Informed and Connect

The Ministry of Education frequently updates its news and resources, demonstrating its active engagement in promoting international education. Recent activities include:

  • Organizing cultural celebrations like the Dragon Boat Festival for international students.
  • Promoting Taiwan's higher education at international universities and education fairs.
  • Enhancing modern language teaching skills among educators.

For more detailed information on university admissions, scholarships, and language programs, visit the official Study In Taiwan website. Your journey to an enriching education and an unforgettable cultural experience in Taiwan awaits!

For direct inquiries, you may contact the Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan) at: No.5, Zhongshan S. Rd., Zhongzheng Dist., Taipei City 100217, Taiwan (R.O.C.) Tel: 886-2-7736-6666.

pages.title: Top 20 Fully Funded Scholarships for International Students 2026
pages.description: The dream of studying abroad can come with a hefty price tag, but fully funded scholarships can make this dream a reality. These opportunities cover tuition, living expenses, travel, and other costs, allowing students to focus purely on their education.
pages.content:
The dream of studying abroad can come with a hefty price tag. Academic fees, living costs, and currency rates raise the bills exponentially. But fully funded scholarships can make this dream a reality for students seeking quality education. These scholarships cover tuition, living expenses, travel and other miscellaneous costs, allowing the students to focus on education without financial stress.

What Does A Fully Funded Scholarship Mean?

A scholarship that takes care of all costs associated with tuition fees, housing, transportation, and daily living throughout the entire duration of the program is called a Fully Funded Scholarship.

Many universities offer Scholarships and fellowships to deserving students based on their merit and financial need. Colleges do this to provide meritorious students an opportunity to grow in their academics and careers. This also helps them to diversify the crowd of students pursuing their education at their university.

Scholarships come in many different forms. Some offer the complete tuition fee, some offer partial funding, and some scholarships are fully funded. Partially funded scholarships offer a percentage of the costs required to complete your degree and not the entire amount.

With a fully funded scholarship, international students don’t have to worry about any of the costs associated with pursuing their higher education abroad and focus on their academics instead of trying to find a part-time job to meet their financial requirements while pursuing their studies.

Top 20 Fully Funded Scholarships 2026

In this blog, we are providing you with a list of the best 20 fully funded scholarships that Indian and International students can apply for. Various Governments, Universities, and foundations around the world offer these scholarships.

These 20 are just the start. See the ones you actually qualify for. Filter by your nationality, course, destination country and funding type - and get a shortlist built around your profile in under a minute.

pages.content:

The Erasmus Mundus Scholarship, officially offered through the Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) program, represents an extraordinary chance for ambitious students from around the world. About the Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (EMJM) Program

The EMJM program funds high-quality integrated master's programs offered by international consortia of universities. These programs are characterized by their interdisciplinary nature, international mobility, and joint or multiple degrees awarded upon completion. The scholarship covers tuition fees, travel, living expenses, and insurance, making it one of the most comprehensive scholarships available globally.

Key Benefits of the EMJM Scholarship

  • Fully Funded: Comprehensive coverage including tuition fees, travel costs, visa expenses, and a monthly living allowance.
  • International Mobility: Opportunity to study in multiple European countries, gaining diverse academic and cultural experiences.

pages.title: Fully Funded Master's & PhD: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028
pages.description: Dreaming of advanced study in Switzerland? The prestigious Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for 2027-2028 offer fully funded Master's and PhD opportunities across diverse fields. Prepare to embark on a world-class academic journey supported by the Swiss Confederation.
pages.content:
Imagine advancing your research or artistic career amidst the breathtaking landscapes and world-renowned academic institutions of Switzerland. The good news? The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for the 2027-2028 academic year are your golden ticket! Offered by the Swiss Confederation, these prestigious scholarships aim to foster international exchange and research cooperation, attracting top talent from over 180 countries worldwide.

This is a truly exceptional opportunity for ambitious international students and researchers looking to pursue Master's or PhD-level studies in a stimulating and innovative environment. If you've ever dreamt of fully funded postgraduate education in one of Europe's most beautiful and academically rigorous countries, keep reading to discover how you can make that dream a reality.

Eligibility Criteria: Are You Ready for Switzerland?

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are highly competitive and seek out talented individuals committed to academic or artistic excellence. Here's a breakdown of the key eligibility requirements:

  • Academic Level: These scholarships primarily target early career researchers who have completed their Master's degree for research scholarships (PhD or Postdoctoral research), and those pursuing an initial Master's degree in artistic fields for art scholarships.
  • Country of Origin: Applicants from over 180 countries are eligible to apply, making this a truly global opportunity.
  • Academic Supervisor (for Research Scholarships): A crucial requirement for research scholarship applicants is to secure an academic supervisor at a Swiss university or federal institute who is willing to guide your research project. This step is often foundational to a successful application.
  • Field of Study: The scholarships cover a wide range of academic and artistic fields, allowing you to pursue your passion whether it's in science, humanities, engineering, or the arts.
  • Previous Stay in Switzerland: Specific conditions regarding previous stays in Switzerland may apply, so it's essential to check the detailed guidelines for your country.

Unbeatable Benefits: What the Scholarship Offers

Being a recipient of the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship means more than just funding; it's an investment in your future. The scholarship package is designed to provide comprehensive support:

  • Generous Monthly Stipend: Research scholars receive a substantial stipend of CHF 2450 per month, ensuring you can focus entirely on your studies and research without financial worry.
  • Full Funding: These are 'Excellence Scholarships,' implying a fully funded opportunity, typically covering living costs, tuition fees (in some cases, specific details vary by institution and scholarship type), and often other benefits like health insurance and travel allowances.
  • World-Class Education: Gain access to Switzerland's renowned universities and federal institutes, known for their cutting-edge research, innovation, and high academic standards.
  • Networking Opportunities: Connect with leading academics and researchers in your field, fostering invaluable international collaborations and career prospects.
  • Cultural Immersion: Experience the rich culture, stunning natural beauty, and high quality of life that Switzerland offers.

Application Process & Key Dates for 2027-2028

Planning is key for a successful application. While specific country deadlines will be published later, mark these important dates:

  • Application Opening Date: Applications for the 2027-2028 academic year are scheduled to open on August 20, 2026. This gives you ample time to prepare your documents.
  • Country-Specific Deadlines: Keep a close eye on the official scholarship website for specific application deadlines relevant to your country of origin. These dates vary significantly.
  • Secure a Supervisor: For research scholarships, start identifying and contacting potential academic supervisors at Swiss universities well in advance. A strong letter of support from a professor is critical.
  • Prepare Documentation: Gather all necessary academic transcripts, letters of recommendation, research proposals (if applicable), and other supporting documents.

Don't miss this unparalleled opportunity to advance your academic or artistic journey in Switzerland. Start your preparation now, secure that supervisor, and get ready to apply for the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028!

For the most accurate and detailed information, always refer to the official scholarship portal.

pages.title: Fully Funded DAAD Scholarships: Your Gateway to Study & Research in Germany
pages.description: Dreaming of academic excellence in Germany? The prestigious DAAD scholarships offer fully funded opportunities for Master's, PhD, and Postdoctoral studies across diverse fields. Discover how these non-repayable awards can propel your career forward.
pages.content:
Germany stands as a global beacon for academic innovation and research. If you're an ambitious student or researcher eyeing a world-class education or groundbreaking research experience, the DAAD Scholarships are your golden ticket. The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) is the world's largest funding organization for international academic exchange, and their scholarships are designed to empower talents from around the globe to thrive in Germany.

These scholarships are more than just financial aid; they are an investment in your future, offering comprehensive support that allows you to focus purely on your studies or research. Best of all, DAAD scholarships do not have to be paid back!

Who is Eligible for DAAD Scholarships?

DAAD scholarships primarily target high-achieving individuals looking to pursue advanced academic endeavors in Germany. While specific criteria vary significantly between programs, general eligibility often includes:

  • Graduates pursuing Master's degrees.
  • Doctoral students (PhDs) embarking on their research journey.
  • Postdoctoral researchers seeking to expand their academic horizons.
  • Open to both German and international students and researchers.

It's crucial to consult the DAAD scholarship database for the precise requirements of your desired program.

Unmatched Benefits of DAAD Scholarships

Beyond the prestige, DAAD scholarships offer a robust package designed to cover essential living and study costs, ensuring a comfortable and focused academic experience:

  • Generous Monthly Scholarship Payment: Enjoy financial security with payments typically around €992 for students (Master's level) and €1,300 for doctoral/PhD students and postdocs.
  • Flat-Rate Travel Allowance: Assistance with your travel costs to and from Germany.
