pages.description: Dreaming of a Master's degree in Finland? Non-EU/EEA students can now apply for the prestigious Finland Scholarship, offering a full tuition waiver and a generous relocation grant for your first year of studies.
pages.content:
Dreaming of advancing your education in a land renowned for its innovation, breathtaking nature, and world-class universities? The Finland Scholarship offers an incredible opportunity for international students to pursue a Master's degree with significant financial support. If you're a non-EU/EEA citizen eager to experience Finnish academic excellence, this fully funded scholarship could be your gateway!

Eligibility for the Finland Scholarship

To be considered for this prestigious award, applicants must meet specific criteria:

  • You must be a non-EU/EEA citizen. This scholarship is specifically designed for students from outside the European Union and European Economic Area.
  • You must be liable for tuition fees at a Finnish university.
  • You must be applying to an English-taught Master's program at a Finnish higher education institution. The scholarship is awarded for the first year of Master's studies.
  • Applications must be submitted through the official Studyinfo portal concurrently with your application for a study place.

Benefits of the Finland Scholarship

The Finland Scholarship is designed to alleviate the financial burden of international study, offering substantial benefits:

  • Full Tuition-Fee Waiver: Awardees receive a complete waiver of tuition fees for their first year of Master's studies. This is a significant saving, making world-class education accessible.
  • Relocation Grant: In addition to the tuition waiver, scholarship recipients will receive a one-off €2,000 relocation grant. This grant helps cover initial costs associated with moving to Finland and settling in.

It's important to note that while the scholarship covers the first year's tuition and provides a relocation grant, recipients are responsible for their living costs beyond the €2,000 grant.

How to Apply

Applying for the Finland Scholarship is an integrated process with your university application:

  • Identify an English-taught Master's program in Finland that aligns with your academic and career goals.
  • Initiate your application through the official Studyinfo portal.
  • Ensure you apply for the Finland Scholarship at the same time as you submit your application for a study place. The scholarship application is often a part of the university's general application process for international students.
  • Carefully review the specific application instructions provided by your chosen Finnish university, as procedures may vary slightly.

Important Deadline

Mark your calendars! The application deadline for the Finland Scholarship is:

  • January 31, 2026

Prospective students are strongly encouraged to prepare all necessary documents well in advance of this date.

Take the Next Step!

The Finland Scholarship is a fantastic opportunity for ambitious non-EU/EEA students to pursue their Master's dreams in one of Europe's most innovative countries. Don't miss out on this chance to gain a world-class education with significant financial support.

For more detailed information and to begin your application process, visit the official source: Finland Scholarship Official Link.

Prepare your application, highlight your academic achievements, and get ready to embark on an unforgettable academic journey in Finland!

Severo Ochoa PhD Fellowship – Biomedical Engineering offers a fully funded opportunity for international scholars to pursue a doctorate at top Spanish universities.

Eligibility

  • Master's degree with a research component
  • English proficiency (TOEFL ≥90)
  • Outstanding academic record

Benefits

  • Full tuition coverage
  • €1,800 monthly stipend
  • Health insurance

Deadline

Applications close on 30 November 2026. Apply now at the official portal.

pages.title: Research Council of Norway PhD Scholarship – Sustainable Energy: Fully Funded Opportunity for Renewable Energy Researchers
pages.description: The Research Council of Norway offers a fully funded PhD scholarship in Sustainable Energy, covering a generous salary and tuition. Open to international candidates with a master’s in Energy Engineering or related fields.
pages.content:
The Research Council of Norway invites applications for a prestigious PhD scholarship focused on Sustainable Energy, offering a competitive salary and full coverage of tuition and research costs.

Eligibility

  • International candidates with a master’s degree in Energy Engineering or a related field.
  • Proficiency in English (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90).
  • Required documents: CV, academic transcripts, two recommendation letters, research proposal, and proof of English proficiency.

Benefits

  • Annual salary of NOK 560,000.
  • Full tuition and research allowance.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge renewable energy systems and grid integration projects.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 15 October 2026. Apply now through the official portal.

pages.title: Swedish Institute Study Scholarships 2027: Fully Funded Master’s Opportunities in Humanities
pages.description: Apply for the Swedish Institute Study Scholarships 2027 and receive full tuition plus a generous living allowance for a Master's in Humanities in Sweden.
pages.content:
Discover the Swedish Institute Study Scholarships 2027, a prestigious fully funded opportunity for non‑EU/EEA students to pursue a Master's degree in Humanities at top Swedish universities.

Eligibility

  • Applicants must be non‑EU/EEA nationals.
  • Hold a bachelor's degree with a minimum GPA of 3.0.
  • Demonstrate English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90).
  • Required documents: CV, motivation letter, academic transcripts, two references, and proof of language proficiency.

Benefits

  • Full tuition coverage for the entire Master's programme.
  • Monthly living allowance of SEK 9,000.
  • Access to Swedish academic networks and cultural experiences.

Deadline

The application window closes on 1 December 2026. Early preparation is recommended.

pages.title: Apply Now: EDUFI Doctoral Fellowship 2027 – Fully Funded PhD in Finland
pages.description: The EDUFI Doctoral Fellowship 2027 offers international scholars a fully funded PhD opportunity in Finland, covering tuition, a monthly stipend, and travel costs. Apply before the November 15 deadline to advance your research at a top Finnish university.
pages.content:
Eligibility

  • International PhD candidates in any discipline
  • Master's degree with minimum GPA 3.0
  • English proficiency: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90
  • Required documents: research proposal, CV, academic transcripts, two recommendation letters, proof of language proficiency

Benefits

  • Full tuition coverage
  • €1,500 monthly stipend
  • Travel allowance for research trips
  • Opportunity to study at a Finnish university

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 15 November 2026.

For full details and to apply, visit the official EDUFI fellowship page.

pages.title: Fully Funded DAAD Undergraduate Engineering Scholarships in Germany – Apply for 2026
pages.description: The DAAD offers fully funded scholarships for international students pursuing a Bachelor’s in Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering in Germany. Apply by November 30, 2026 to cover tuition, a €800 monthly stipend, and health insurance.
pages.content:
DAAD Study Scholarships – Undergraduate (Bachelor) Program provide a rare opportunity for high‑achieving students to study engineering in Germany with full tuition coverage, a monthly stipend, and health insurance.

Eligibility

  • International applicants with a secondary school certificate equivalent to the German Abitur.
  • Accepted into a Bachelor’s program in Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering at a German university.
  • Proficiency in English (IELTS ≥ 6.0) or German (TestDaF ≥ 14).
  • Required documents: certified school transcripts, CV, motivation letter, language certificates, and two recommendation letters.

Benefits

  • Full tuition waiver.
  • €800 monthly stipend for living expenses.
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
  • Access to DAAD’s extensive academic network and support services.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 30 November 2026. Early preparation is advised to gather all required documents.

For full details and to apply, visit the official DAAD scholarship page.

pages.title: Fully Funded DAAD Research Grants for Doctoral Candidates – Study in Germany
pages.description: The DAAD offers fully funded research grants for international doctoral candidates to pursue PhDs in Germany. Benefit from tuition coverage, a monthly stipend, health insurance, and travel allowance.
pages.content:
The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) provides a prestigious, fully funded research grant for outstanding international scholars aiming to earn a PhD at a German university.

Eligibility

  • Hold a recognized Master’s degree (or equivalent).
  • Be an international applicant (non‑German resident).
  • Submit a research proposal in collaboration with a German host institution.
  • Demonstrate language proficiency (IELTS ≥6.5 or TestDaF ≥16).
  • Provide academic transcripts, CV, two recommendation letters, and a detailed research proposal.

Benefits

  • Full tuition waiver at the host university.
  • Monthly stipend of €850 to cover living costs.
  • Comprehensive health insurance.
  • Travel allowance for arrival and return to Germany.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 15 December 2026. Early preparation is recommended to secure a host supervisor.

For full details and to apply, visit the official DAAD scholarship page.

pages.title: Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics Postdoctoral Fellowship – Fully Funded Astrophysics Opportunity
pages.description: Secure a prestigious postdoctoral fellowship at the Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics. This fully funded position supports independent research in theoretical or observational astrophysics.
pages.content:
Eligibility

  • Citizenship: Open to international candidates.
  • Education: Ph.D. in astrophysics or a closely related field.
  • Application Materials: CV, publication list, research plan, two recommendation letters, and language proficiency proof if required.

Benefits

  • Salary: Equivalent to TVöD E13 (fully funded).
  • Research Funds: Additional budget for equipment, travel, and conference participation.
  • Institutional Support: Access to world‑class facilities, mentorship, and collaborative networks at the Max Planck Institute.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 1 December 2026. Apply online at the official fellowship page.

pages.title: ETH Zurich International Internship Programme – Summer Research Internship (Fully Funded 8‑12‑Week Experience)
pages.description: Earn a CHF 2,000/month stipend and accommodation support while conducting cutting‑edge research at ETH Zurich. Open to undergraduate and master’s students worldwide for an 8‑12 week summer internship.
pages.content:
Looking for a prestigious, fully funded research opportunity in Europe? The ETH Zurich International Internship Programme – Summer Research Internship offers students a chance to work alongside world‑class researchers at one of the world’s top technical universities.

Eligibility

  • Undergraduate or master’s students enrolled in a university program.
  • Minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 (or equivalent).
  • Propose a research project in collaboration with an ETH Zurich supervisor.
  • Required documents: CV, academic transcript, motivation letter, project description, and a letter of endorsement from the prospective ETH supervisor.
  • Open to applicants from any country.

Benefits

  • Stipend: CHF 2,000 per month.
  • Accommodation support: assistance in finding housing during the internship.
  • Hands‑on research experience at a leading multidisciplinary institution.
  • Opportunity to expand your professional network with top scientists and industry partners.
  • Certificate of completion and potential for future collaborations.

Deadline

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. Early submission is encouraged to secure a placement.

For full details and to apply, visit the official ETH Zurich internship page.

pages.title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship for MBA – Full Funding in France
pages.description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship provides a fully funded MBA at a top French Grande École, covering tuition, living stipend, and travel costs. Open to high‑achieving international students with leadership potential.
pages.content:
The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship, funded by the French Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs, offers a fully‑funded Master in Business Administration at a prestigious French Grande École. This prestigious award targets top international talent seeking a world‑class MBA experience in France.

Eligibility

  • Bachelor’s degree with high academic standing
  • Demonstrated leadership potential
  • Proficiency in English or French (language certificates required)
  • Strong motivation expressed in a personal statement
  • Two academic or professional recommendation letters

Benefits

  • Full tuition coverage for the 2‑year MBA program
  • Monthly stipend of €1,200 for living expenses
  • Travel allowance of €1,500 for round‑trip airfare
  • Access to the French Ministry’s network and alumni community

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 15 October 2026. Early submission is encouraged.

pages.title: DAAD Master’s Scholarship 2026/27: Fully Funded Engineering Degrees in Germany
pages.description: The DAAD offers a fully funded Master’s scholarship for engineering students to study in Germany for the 2026/27 academic year. Applicants enjoy tuition coverage, a monthly stipend, and health insurance.
pages.content:
Dreaming of an engineering master’s degree in Germany without financial worries? The German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) has opened its 2026/27 Master’s Scholarship to qualified international students, covering tuition, living costs, and health insurance.

Eligibility

  • International students with a bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related fields.
  • Minimum GPA of 3.0.
  • English proficiency: IELTS ≥ 6.5 or TOEFL ≥ 90.
  • If the program is in German, German proficiency: TestDaF ≥ 16.
  • Required documents: academic transcript, CV, two recommendation letters, research proposal, language certificates, and a motivation letter.

Benefits

  • Full tuition coverage.
  • Monthly stipend of €850.
  • Health insurance provided.
  • Opportunity to study at top German engineering universities.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 15 October 2026.

pages.title: Fully Funded EPFL Doctoral Fellowship for Life Sciences PhD – Apply by Nov 2026
pages.description: Earn a fully funded PhD at EPFL with tuition covered, a CHF 2,800 monthly stipend, and health insurance. Applications close on 30 November 2026.
pages.content:
EPFL’s SNSF Excellence Fellowship offers international researchers a chance to pursue a fully funded PhD in Life Sciences at one of Europe’s top universities.

Eligibility

  • International candidates commencing a PhD in Life Sciences at EPFL.
  • Master’s degree with a minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0.
  • English proficiency: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90.
  • Required documents: research proposal, CV, academic transcripts, three recommendation letters, proof of English proficiency, and a signed host supervisor agreement.

Benefits

  • Full tuition waiver.
  • Monthly stipend of CHF 2,800.
  • Comprehensive health insurance.
  • Access to world‑class labs and mentorship at EPFL.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 30 November 2026. Early submission is encouraged.

Ready to launch your PhD journey? Apply now.

pages.title: Fully Funded ETH Zurich Doctoral Fellowship for Engineering PhD – Apply Now
pages.description: The ETH Zurich Doctoral Fellowship offers a fully funded PhD position in Engineering, covering tuition and a generous stipend. Applicants with a strong research proposal and English proficiency can apply before the 1 December 2026 deadline.
pages.content:
The ETH Zurich Doctoral Fellowship provides a fully funded PhD opportunity in Engineering at one of the world’s leading technical universities. Successful candidates receive full tuition coverage, a CHF 3,000 monthly stipend, and a research travel allowance.

Eligibility

  • Admission to a PhD programme in Engineering at ETH Zurich.
  • Relevant Master’s degree.
  • Strong research proposal.
  • English proficiency: IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL iBT 100.
  • Required documents: PhD project proposal, CV, academic transcripts, two recommendation letters, proof of English proficiency, and admission letter.

Benefits

  • Full tuition coverage.
  • Monthly stipend of CHF 3,000.
  • Research travel allowance.
  • Access to world‑class facilities and mentorship.

Deadline

Applications must be submitted by 1 December 2026. Early submission is encouraged.

For more details and to apply, visit the ETH Zurich Doctoral Fellowship page.
